links.outcome: Whether pathologist verification of AI-labeled candidates filters out CMV mimics
links.effect: Reported qualitatively: the human-in-the-loop workflow mitigated mimics such as reactive endothelial nuclei; no numeric error-catch rate given.
links.quote: The "human-in-the-loop" workflow successfully mitigated common mimics, such as reactive endothelial nuclei, through automated candidate labeling and rapid pathologist verification.
